title: Causal Bias Detection in Generative Artifical Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in large language models by comparing real-world survey data (NSDUH, BRFSS) with model-generated responses to quantify direct, indirect, and spurious causal effects of race on predicted substance abuse (marijuana use) and chronic disease (diabetes diagnosis).

Applying a causal fairness framework to compare real-world census data (ACS Census) with LLM-generated predictions to quantify changes in direct, indirect, and spurious causal effects of sex on predicted income levels.
